column1: # The second channel (HERESY 2946): where a model file comes from
# when Hugging Face does not give it whole and right. tools/hf_channels.py reads this; Hugging Face (with Xet) is always first and is not listed.
# A line is tried, in this order, only for a file Hugging Face did not deliver, and only when its SHA-256 is known before it comes (heresy/hf-manifest.tsv
# for goldhub/*, Hugging Face's own pinned list for another's repo). What a channel sends is held to that SHA-256: no channel is trusted for content.
#   endpoint  a Hugging Face-compatible host: «hf download» again with HF_ENDPOINT=where and Xet off
#   url       one file's address with {sha256} {sha1} {sha2} {repo} {owner} {name} {rev} {path} {file} filled in, and {part}: "" for a whole file,
#             .part000, .part001… for the pieces of a file over split bytes (GitHub takes no file of 2 GiB)
#   a line starting with # is off: the three below wait for accounts of their own (OWNER, REPO and DOMAIN to fill in)
